answer: Sybil resistance derives from reputation with an exponential temporal half-life: absent sustained honest service, an identity’s score rapidly decays. EigenTrust matrix factorization assigns freshly spawned identities near-zero eigenvector centrality because they have no trusted incoming mass; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot bootstrap isolated colluders. Thus, whether clustered at a wharf, glacier, or reef, sybils lack durable support and cannot pass consensus.
